analogy.rationale: Orexin receptors (HCRTR1/2) are GPCRs with little to no expression in these cell lines, so orexin antagonists should elicit minimal transcriptional response. Other GPCR-targeting antagonist classes, especially neuropeptide receptor antagonists, are expected to behave similarly with little or no response.
